content.short: Oxygen enables collateral reuse, cross-collateralization, and market-based pricing for DeFi borrowing, lending, and trading on Solana.
content.description: Oxygen is a DeFi prime brokerage built on Solana that relies on Serum's on-chain infrastructure to deliver capital-efficient finance. Users can manage capital more efficiently by using the same collateral across multiple positions, gaining cross-collateralization and pricing that reflects market dynamics. The platform supports developers with an API for DeFi programs, enabling integration and programmatic access. Oxygen emphasizes scalability and aims to democratize borrowing, lending, and leveraged trading for a broad user base.
